Mia (PM): Heads-up — competitor pushed a public on-demand model routing feature that overlaps with our routing controls. Customers are asking if we can match. Do we try parity or double-down on our differentiators? :thinking:
Arjun (Eng): Can you drop the public notes/PR here? I need to see if their approach affects runtime/kernel-level stuff or is purely policy surface.
Lila (Sales): Several enterprise POCs (Acme, Beacon) have explicitly asked for per-route SLA + region pinning. Sales needs a clear answer this week before committing to demos.
Ben (SE): Suggest a 3-step path: 1) routing-policy parity MVP, 2) attach our cost-aware controls & caching later, 3) canary on Dedicated. Parity MVP can be lightweight if we scope it.
Arjun (Eng): Parity MVP still requires: policy evaluator, fallback chains, metrics hooks. Rough: 2 engineers x 2 weeks for a prototype + infra for canary. Main risk is token path perf regression.
Mia (PM): Launch criteria proposal:
```text
SLO: p95 latency <= baseline * 1.10
Cost: uplift <= +15% per 1M tokens baseline
Quality: regression <2% on eval set
Canary: must run on Dedicated pool with tracing
```
Thoughts?
Lila (Sales): If we can hit those gates, sales will schedule Q2 POCs. Timeline needs to be firm though — customers want dates.
Arjun (Eng): 2 weeks to run an engineering spike + prototype. Production hardening (RBAC, KMS, rollout policies) will add ~4–6 weeks. I can prioritize a 2-week spike to prove no perf cliff.
Ben (SE): We should lock a "critical 20%" scope for parity: route by region, route by model family, fallback to cheaper variant. Defer UI polish and docs to a follow-up.
Mia (PM): Agreed — I'll split acceptance criteria into 'must' vs 'stretch' and create the eval harness for customer prompts.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary environment reserved for spike on 3 nodes (g4dn) — booking confirmed.
Lila (Sales): If canary starts in 2 weeks, we can demo to Acme + Beacon. Please surface risks early so sales can set expectations.
Ben (SE): I'll draft a smoke test suite and a small prompt eval set. Will submit PR to /repo/priority/parity-eval this afternoon.
Mia (PM): Action items: Arjun + Ben run 2-week spike; Mia to write acceptance criteria and coordinate sales; Lila to lock POC dates. Re-evaluate after spike. :rocket:
